decision: TO-A continuous-loop study lead, conditional on survey/vehicle design; not a final site alignment or owner property choice

alternatives.name: Continuous one-direction loop
alternatives.normal: Locomotive leads the same consist around a continuous route through origin andNorthPole stops.
alternatives.benefit: Avoids routine pushing, running around and passenger-service recoupling.
alternatives.condition: Study lead only if actual boundary/terrain can support a0%route with accepted curves, two boarding locations and emergency/maintenance access.
alternatives.new_interfaces: Protected stops and occupancy/dispatch; future second train still needs engineered separation and blocked-route response.

alternatives.name: Point-to-point with terminal balloon loops
alternatives.normal: Train turns on track at each end and locomotive leads both travel directions on the shared stem.
alternatives.benefit: Can preserve locomotive-leading operation when an outbound/return stem is needed.
alternatives.condition: Requires actual land and acceptable curve/swept envelopes at BOTHends, plus engineered turnouts and route protection. No minimum radius or loop footprint is selected.
alternatives.new_interfaces: Opposing movements on common track, point position/locking and fouling protection; no default trailing-point movement.

alternatives.name: Point-to-point reversing / push-pull
alternatives.normal: Whole consist reverses; locomotive at one end pushes on one leg unless another accepted drive/control arrangement is developed.
alternatives.benefit: May avoid terminal loop footprints; not an automatic reduction in total system complexity.
alternatives.condition: Not cleared for normal service: leading-end visibility/control, braking in both directions, compressive coupling stability and protected doors/platforms need new integrated validation.
alternatives.new_interfaces: Accepted leading-end control and communication; reversal/rollback/retarding behavior and trainline failure cases. A diesel reverser alone does not qualify a pushed passenger consist.

alternatives.name: Locomotive run-around
alternatives.normal: Locomotive disconnects, changes end using additional track and reconnects.
alternatives.benefit: Can restore locomotive-leading direction without turning the complete consist.
alternatives.condition: Not preferred normal guest cycle: extra movements, turnouts, physical couplings/hoses, positive coach restraint and post-reconnection checks require an approved operating case.
alternatives.new_interfaces: Controlled uncoupling/air isolation/parking/recharge/brake continuity; no assumption that passengers may remain aboard during shunting.

normal_boarding: Retain controlled near-level station boarding at origin andNorthPole as development lead; actual loaded level, gap/bridge and accessible solution unresolved.
emergency: Do not rely solely on reversing/towing to a station: fire, blocked track or brake/control failure may prevent it. Off-station evacuation must remain coordinated with terrain, access, lights and qualified response.
next: Consolidate all subsystem drawing/interface/release status under3S; complete supportable procurement/fabrication/installation/commissioning records, not repeated held geometry.
